title: QA Pilot Registry Change Receipt
description: Schema for governed QA Pilot registry change receipts. Every sprint that may affect the pipeline layer registry must produce a receipt declaring its registry impact class (adds_layer, updates_layer, no_registry_impact, deprecates_layer). Advisory-only, QA Pilot-local.

receipt_id.description: Unique registry change receipt identifier (e.g. RCR-ADD-LAYER-048).

sprint_id.description: The sprint ID that produced this registry change.

registry_impact.description: How this sprint affects the layer registry.

registry_before_summary.description: Registry state summary before this sprint's change.

registry_after_summary.description: Registry state summary after this sprint's change.

layer_slot_added.description: Slot number of the layer added (only when registry_impact=adds_layer).

layer_slot_deprecated.description: Slot number of the layer deprecated (only when registry_impact=deprecates_layer).

rationale.description: Rationale for the registry impact classification. Must be >= 20 chars for no_registry_impact.

advisory_only.description: All registry change receipts are advisory. Must be true.

librarian_impact.description: No Librarian mutation permitted. Must be none.

not_seal_authority.description: Explicit assertion that this receipt does not confer sealing authority.

not_librarian_mutation_authority.description: Explicit assertion that this receipt does not authorize Librarian mutation.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this receipt was created.

created_by.description: Agent or tool that created this receipt.

allOf.description: If registry_impact=no_registry_impact, rationale must be >= 20 chars.
